en.name: Fruit cocktail, canned
en.summary: An unopened can of fruit cocktail keeps up to 18 months in the cupboard. Opening it turns it into a refrigerated food that lasts a matter of days, so the shelf figure never stands for both states.
en.pantry: Cool, dry and dark, up to 18 months from the date on the can. Canned fruit is a high-acid food, which is the easy end of canning and part of why the syrup keeps the fruit looking respectable for so long; what fades first is colour and firmness rather than safety. Store cans off damp concrete and away from the hob, and do not keep them above the oven. A can that is bulging, leaking, seriously dented on a seam, or that hisses or spurts when you pierce it goes into the bin unopened — never taste it to check.
en.fridge: The unopened figure does not carry over. Once the lid is off, fruit cocktail is a perishable refrigerated food and keeps only a few days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below; no separate published timeline exists for the opened can, so go by the date you opened it and your nose. For safety you may leave the fruit in the opened can — the tin is not a hazard — but for flavour you should not, because exposed metal gives the syrup a dull metallic edge within a day. Decant fruit and syrup together into a covered glass or plastic container, and keep the fruit under the syrup.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for canned fruit cocktail, and the results are poor: the fruit is already soft from processing, and ice crystals collapse it further, so it thaws to mush. If you want to keep an opened can beyond the fridge window, freezing the syrup with the fruit in an ice cube tray for smoothies or punch is about the only use that survives the texture change.
en.thawing: If you have frozen it, thaw in the fridge and use it in a blended drink or a cooked compote rather than expecting the fruit to hold its shape. Never thaw on the counter.
spoilage: A bulging or leaking can, or one that spurts when opened.
A fermented, yeasty or alcoholic smell from the syrup.
Cloudy, foamy or unusually thick syrup.
Mould on the surface, or fruit that has gone slimy or brown-grey.
tips: Decant leftovers into a covered container and keep the fruit submerged in syrup.
Label the container with the opening date rather than trusting memory.
Rotate cans front to back so the oldest one is always next.
Discard a bulging or spurting can unopened — never taste to test it.

faq.q: How long does canned fruit cocktail keep?
faq.a: Up to 18 months unopened in a cool dry cupboard. Once opened it is a refrigerated food and lasts only a few days.

faq.q: Can you leave fruit in the opened can?
faq.a: It is safe, but the syrup picks up a metallic taste. Transfer fruit and syrup to a covered container instead.

faq.q: Can you freeze canned fruit cocktail?
faq.a: No timeline is published and the texture suffers badly. Freeze it only for smoothies or compote, not to serve as fruit.

zh.name: 什錦水果罐頭
zh.summary: 未開封的什錦水果罐頭放櫥櫃最長可放 18 個月。一旦打開，它就變成只能放幾天的冷藏食品——那個架上的數字，永遠不能同時代表兩種狀態。
zh.pantry: 陰涼、乾燥、避光，自罐上日期起最長 18 個月。水果罐頭屬於高酸性食品，是罐頭裡比較好處理的一端，糖水也讓水果外觀撐得比較久；先衰退的是顏色和口感，而不是安全性。罐頭不要直接放在潮濕的水泥地，也不要放在爐台或烤箱上方。罐身膨脹、滲漏、接縫嚴重凹陷，或開罐時洩氣、噴汁的，請不要打開、直接丟棄——絕對不要靠試吃來判斷。
zh.fridge: 未開封的數字不能延用。蓋子一掀，什錦水果就是易腐的冷藏食品，在 4 °C 以下只能放幾天；開罐後並沒有另外公布的期限，所以請以開罐日期加上自己的鼻子為準。就安全而言，水果留在開過的罐子裡是可以的，罐體本身不是危害；但為了味道不建議這麼做，因為裸露的金屬一天內就會讓糖水帶一點鈍鈍的金屬味。請把水果連同糖水一起換到加蓋的玻璃或塑膠容器，並讓水果浸在糖水裡。
zh.freezer: 什錦水果罐頭沒有公布的冷凍期限，而且效果不好：水果經過加工本來就軟，冰晶會讓它更塌，解凍後幾乎成泥。如果真的想讓開過的罐頭撐過冷藏期，把糖水連水果倒進製冰盒冷凍、之後打果昔或調飲料，大概是唯一撐得過質地改變的用法。
zh.thawing: 如果已經冷凍了，請放冷藏解凍，並用在打成飲品或煮成果醬類的用途，不要期待水果還能保持形狀。不要放室溫退冰。
spoilage: 罐身膨脹、滲漏，或開罐時噴汁。
糖水聞起來有發酵味、酵母味或酒味。
糖水變混濁、起泡，或異常濃稠。
表面長霉，或水果變得黏滑、呈灰褐色。
tips: 剩料換到加蓋容器，並讓水果浸在糖水裡。
在容器上寫開罐日期，不要靠記憶。
罐頭由前往後輪替，永遠先用最舊的。
膨脹或噴汁的罐頭不要開、不要嚐，直接丟。

faq.q: 什錦水果罐頭可以放多久？
faq.a: 未開封放陰涼乾燥的櫥櫃最長 18 個月。開封後就是冷藏食品，只能放幾天。

faq.q: 水果可以留在開過的罐子裡嗎？
faq.a: 安全上可以，但糖水會帶金屬味。建議連糖水一起換到加蓋容器。

faq.q: 什錦水果罐頭可以冷凍嗎？
faq.a: 沒有公布的期限，而且口感會嚴重受損。只適合用來打果昔或煮成醬，不適合當水果吃。
